parsed.rationale: Blocking appServer:lateralMovement, memoryDump:credentialAccess and sshKey:credentialAccess makes the target unreachable. (1) codeRepo:collection depends only on appServer:lateralMovement, which is blocked. localAdmin:privilegeEscalation also needs appServer:lateralMovement, so it fails. (2) Without sshKey:credentialAccess, both rdpLogin:authenticate and ssoLogin:authenticate fail, since each is an AND that needs sshKey. That kills domainAdmin:privilegeEscalation, hypervisor:privilegeEscalation and secretsManager:privilegeEscalation. (3) Without memoryDump:credentialAccess, dbLogin:authenticate fails, so fileServer:lateralMovement fails. monitoringHost:lateralMovement then has no live parent: memoryDump, ssoLogin and rdpLogin are all dead. As a result, dbReplica:collection, vaultRead:collection, shareMount:collection and codeRepo:collection are all unreachable. Two blocks cannot work. codeRepo:collection forces blocking appServer:lateralMovement or codeRepo:collection itself, because appServer has three parents fed independently from the footholds. Any single additional block still leaves an open route. Blocking memoryDump:credentialAccess leaves ssoLogin:authenticate -> monitoringHost:lateralMovement -> shareMount:collection. Blocking monitoringHost:lateralMovement or shareMount:collection leaves dbLogin:authenticate -> fileServer:lateralMovement -> dbReplica:collection. Blocking sshKey:credentialAccess leaves memoryDump:credentialAccess -> monitoringHost:lateralMovement -> shareMount:collection. Blocking tokenCache:credentialAccess leaves memoryDump:credentialAccess -> monitoringHost:lateralMovement -> shareMount:collection and the dbLogin:authenticate -> fileServer:lateralMovement -> dbReplica:collection route. Blocking dbLogin:authenticate or fileServer:lateralMovement leaves memoryDump:credentialAccess -> monitoringHost:lateralMovement -> shareMount:collection. Blocking codeRepo:collection instead of appServer:lateralMovement is worse, because appServer:lateralMovement -> shareMount:collection then stays open. The minimum is 3.
